definitions.explanation: A box or container for storing and organizing tools. Can refer to a physical toolbox for carpentry or repairs, or a box for art supplies and other implements.

examples.japanese: {道具箱|どうぐばこ}からハンマーを{取|と}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I took a hammer out of the toolbox.

examples.japanese: {図工|ずこう}の{道具箱|どうぐばこ}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}いてください。
examples.english: Please write your name on the arts and crafts toolbox.

examples.japanese: {道具箱|どうぐばこ}の{中|なか}が{散|ち}らかっていて、{必要|ひつよう}なネジが{見|み}つからなかった。
examples.english: The toolbox was such a mess that I couldn't find the screws I needed.

notes:
USAGE:
{道具箱|どうぐばこ} is a straightforward compound of {道具|どうぐ} (tools) and {箱|はこ} (box). In Japanese elementary schools, students have a {道具箱|どうぐばこ} for art and craft supplies that they keep at their desks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}から{取|と}り{出|だ}す (to take out from the toolbox)
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}を{整理|せいり}する (to organize the toolbox)
- {道具箱|どうぐばこ}に{入|い}れる (to put in the toolbox)
